boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 115 splits the board into three columns gated by directional arrows — green, pink, and blue go up while red, yellow, and orange go down. A pink dotted connector between two `7` pairs is the key piece: drop it through the middle column first and the stacks above can finally drain. Touch the left-column `1` stack before the center reshapes and the connector gets buried.
landmarks: Block Out Level 115 splits the board into three columns gated by directional arrows — green, pink, and blue go up while red, yellow, and orange go down.
A pink dotted connector between two `7` pairs is the key piece: drop it through the middle column first and the stacks above can finally drain.
Touch the left-column `1` stack before the center reshapes and the connector gets buried.

quickTips: The pink dotted connector must drop before any `7` pair can split.
Clear the right lone `1` through the orange down-arrow to open the right lane early.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Pull the pink dotted connector downward through the middle column using the yellow down-arrow.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed the upper left `1` stack of three cyan tiles down through the red column arrow.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the lone right-column cyan `1` through the orange down-arrow to open the right lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Split the upper `7` pair in the middle column once the connector has passed the pink up-triangle.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Send the lower left `1` stack through the red down-arrow after the upper `7`s are gone.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Drain the lower `7` pair out through the yellow down-arrow and exit the remaining green column pieces.

failurePoints: Moving a left-column `1` stack before the pink dotted connector has dropped.
Trying to split the `7` pairs while the connector still sits between them.
